root_cause_analysis: OAuthException Code 200: Unpublished photo upload failed because the request was authenticated with a User Access Token or an unauthorized identity instead of the Page Access Token for the target Facebook Page.
actionable_instructions: Verify that the access token used is a Page Access Token with 'pages_manage_posts' and 'pages_read_engagement' permissions.
Ensure the API request is posting to the Page endpoint (/me/photos or /{page-id}/photos) explicitly acting as the Page itself.
Regenerate and update the Facebook Page Access Token in the credentials store.
